source_integrity.summary: Downloaded complete EN and PT-BR staged manuscripts and pending v2, verified corresponding immutable Git blob SHAs and 145 numbered sections per language. No earlier public record for this article.

schema_and_taxonomy.summary: Recognized v2 EN-first research-report, technology-production-society primary program, controlled energy-materials-industrial-systems / industrial-capacity-supply-chains, Brazil geographical scope, valid topic and phenomena selections.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: Verified 2025 ABINEE sector series in the 2026 consolidated publication, Law 14,968/2024 and Decree 13,065/2026 on Senado; checked current OECD, USGS, NIST, SIA, IEA 2026, SEMI Q3 2026, India Government 2026, Softex, ABISEMI and Taiwan ITRI source publications. 2027-2051 paths are conditional.

factual_methodology.summary: ABINEE sector imports 2025 US$48.734bn, exports US$8.146bn, chip imports US$5.963bn; six-year chip import series [4.4288,5.5839,6.3480,5.2280,6.3090,5.9629] in nominal US$bn FOB checked from SECEX/MDIC through ABINEE. NIST TSMC Arizona >US$65bn for three fabs and SIA 67k labor shortfall confirmed; hypothetical portfolio and examples clearly marked.

research_depth.summary: Full 25058 EN and 27446 PT substantive words, 145 numbered sections, appendices A-H, global supply chains, full minerals and chemicals, education, private/public financing and annual scenarios until 2051. 20 cited EN URLs / 20 PT URLs, multiple primary hosts.

evidence_traceability.summary: Cross-checked representative quantitative, institutional, regional and historic claims against dated ABINEE, Senado, OECD, NIST, USGS, IEA, SIA, Government of India, Softex, ABISEMI and ITRI publications. Publisher search confirms S05 article title/existence; BNDES S14 updated to working canonical source. Proprietary figures, some company-level claims and ECA link were not individually audited.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Both languages have two source-supported ABINEE numeric charts with identical years and values, geographic region map with qualitative limitations, one flow, one mindmap and multiple evidence tables; visual signatures matched.

bilingual_equivalence.summary: Compared full EN/PT manuscripts: 145 numbered chapters 1-145, eight appendices, matching chart arrays, equal 142 table lines, flow, mindmap and regional map, same citations S01-S18 and source URLs, no substantive topic dropped.

counterfactual_review.summary: Sections examine alternatives to frontier fabs, imported versus domestic fabrication, selective specialized semiconductor opportunities, subsidy/fiscal risks, qualification versus installed capacity, and conditional milestones with explicit investment stop conditions and industrial-performance indicators.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Natural institutional prose with no site/process metadescriptions, explicitly qualified hypothetical investments, causality and scenario distinctions. Normal publisher build and live verification still required.

pipeline_validation.summary: Reproduced strict pending metadata, visual, chart parity, word-count, citation-domain and section-count checks from code in repository. Full local npm validate/build unavailable because direct git clone cannot resolve github.com in this environment. Mandatory publisher CI remains.

contrary_evidence: Possession of minerals is not production of electronic-grade inputs.
Prototype or installed capacity is not proof of commercial production yield.
Domestic design and IP can generate economic value with foreign wafer fabrication.
New fabs require stable private demand, operating yield and utilities.
limitations: Model-led QA pass, not external human peer review; selected key sources independently checked, not every technical claim across 145 sections.
Some proprietary cost, yield and company records are inaccessible; scenarios are conditional.
The ECA source and some specialized materials were not fully available to the crawler.
The full npm build could not be executed in this session due to local DNS restrictions; publisher must perform build and live URL checks.
notes: QA review against exact pending and two staged Markdown Git blob SHAs, manual deterministic gate checks, independently opened core primary sources, verified chart data and regulatory texts. Residual source sampling and build constraints explicit.
